answer_1.quote: We investigate the generation, definition, and usage of words, neologisms, and nonce words in the tasks of Reverse Dictionary (RD), Definition Modeling (DM) and Exemplification Modeling (EM).
datasets: nonce words dataset generated with GPT-4o
answer_1.outputs: generated words, definitions, and usage examples

answer_2.quote: We tested several metrics to assess the models' abilities across all tasks. Given the differences between them, some metrics are shared while others are taskspecific.

answer_4.quote: Using the Prolific platform, we collected human judgments over 100 pairs of definitions (taken from the nonce words dataset) and nonce words (generated by our models).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to read each definition-word pair and express two judgments about the nonce word on a 5-point Likert scale: the perceived novelty of the word w.r.t. their lexicon and a score of adhesion to the definition.
